diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.prevention: Use instecticide-treated nets, clear stagnant water.

diseases.name: Tuberculosis (TB)
diseases.prevention: BCG vaccination, good ventilation, wearing of face masks

diseases.name: Typoid
diseases.prevention: Drink safe treated water, proper sanitation, handwashing

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.prevention: Avoid close contact, wash hands frequently

diseases.name: Bilharzia
diseases.prevention: Drink boiled/chlorinated water, safe food preparation
diseases.medication: Oral Rehydration Salts(ORS), Intravenous fluids, Zinc supplements

diseases.name: Bilharzia
diseases.prevention: Avoid swimming or wading in fresh water infested with snails

diseases.name: Amoebiasis
diseases.prevention: Proper sewage disposal, wash vegetables and fruits with clean water
